_comment: Inspiring set for the Cookie/Cake Recipe Generator assignment. Based on the structure used in Simple PIERRE (Morris et al., 2012), extended with 'category', 'meal_type' and per-ingredient 'role' metadata so the evolutionary algorithm can evaluate recipes more intelligently than a simple ingredient count. Amounts are approximate, scaled to realistic single-batch quantities in grams (g), millilitres (ml) or whole units.

roles.structure: Provides the bulk/structure of the baked good (flours, oats).
roles.fat: Provides richness, tenderness and flavour carrying (butter, oil, shortening).
roles.binding: Binds the other ingredients together (eggs, egg substitutes).
roles.leavening: Makes the product rise (baking soda, baking powder, yeast).
roles.flavour: Adds aromatic/flavour notes without bulk (extracts, spices, zest).
roles.mix-in: Adds texture/flavour pockets (chocolate chips, nuts, dried fruit).
